data.name: Ayraa
data.gender_notes: Ayraa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ayraa is a beautiful Islamic name for girls that has a long and deep meaning. It can be translated to 'Mountain of Light', and it is said to evoke feelings of beauty, gentleness, and grace. This name is perfect for a little girl who is expected to bring light and joy into the world. The name Ayraa carries the meaning “Mountain of light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Ayraa usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
